tools.description: Capture the complete 2D floor plan fitted to its content bounds. Returns a compressed JPEG data URL and its pixel size without changing the user view.
Capture the current 3D design scene from a specified perspective camera position and direction. Returns a compressed JPEG data URL and its pixel size without changing the user view.
List saved history versions of the current design, with optional pagination, time range, and auto/manual save filters.
Restore the current design to a selected history version. The restored design is loaded into the editor and marked dirty so it can be saved as a new version.

Save the current design to the cloud using the editor manual-save workflow. Waits for saving to finish. Fails if the design is not loaded, saving is already in progress, or saving is blocked or cancelled.
